element.definition: [HEDIS] The metadata about a resource. This is content in the resource that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.
[HEDIS] Indicates a practitioner with prescribing authority
[US Core] Practitioner that is able to provide the defined services for the organization.
[US Core] The organization where the Practitioner performs the roles associated.
[US Core] Roles which this practitioner is authorized to perform for the organization.
[US Core] Specific specialty of the practitioner.
[US Core] The location(s) at which this practitioner provides care.
[US Core] Contact details that are specific to the role/location/service.
[US Core] Telecommunications form for contact point - what communications system is required to make use of the contact.
[US Core] The actual contact point details, in a form that is meaningful to the designated communication system (i.e. phone number or email address).
[US Core] Technical endpoints providing access to services operated for the practitioner with this role.
